topics.label: Lecture introduction to complement
topics.groupedBecause: It provides the introductory framing and context for the lecture on complement.

topics.label: Foundations, nomenclature, and central role of C3
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the core biological principles, naming conventions, and the central role of C3 in the complement system.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the three pathways that trigger the complement cascade and converge to reach the activation threshold.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the primary effector functions carried out by complement to eliminate pathogens and promote inflammation.

topics.label: Regulation of complement and host protection
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the regulatory mechanisms that prevent complement from inadvertently damaging host cells.

topics.label: Clinical manifestations of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: It examines the distinct pathological consequences and disease presentations resulting from deficiencies in specific complement proteins.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: It details how pathogens evolve strategies to circumvent complement-mediated destruction, using Staphylococcus aureus as a primary example.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview
topics.groupedBecause: It closes the lecture and outlines the topic of the next session.
